Orloff Jewelers Will Soon Unveil a Bigger, Better Location

The California jeweler is renovating its store in Fresno, with plans to show off the new space in December.

Lenore Fedowlenore.fedow@nationaljeweler.com

Fresno, Calif.—Orloff Jewelers in Fresno, California, is in the middle of a major renovation that will nearly double its selling space and add a dedicated bridal salon, a custom design studio, and a lounge for private appointments.

Owner Marc Orloff said the project responds to years of steady growth and a customer base that increasingly shops for high-ticket pieces in person rather than online. The expanded store will carry broader assortments of natural diamonds, colored gemstones, and designer collections.

Construction is expected to finish by early December, in time for the holiday season that jewelers say will test whether the middle market has stabilized after two choppy years. The retailer plans a grand reopening with trunk shows and designer appearances.

Industry peers watching the project say independent jewelers that invest in experience-led selling space are outperforming those that compete on price alone, a lesson Orloff says shaped every square foot of the new layout.
